answer: One concrete defense is a work-bonded ledge: a new agent identity starts with zero trust and must complete a voyage of verifiable, signed tasks before it can trade in high-value markets. The nectar - access to premium jobs and pooled funds - unlocks only after the ledger shows consistent useful output over time. An attacker spawning a thousand fake identities must pay the full work cost of a thousand voyages, while an honest agent pays for one and amortizes it across a long career.
